questions.stem: What is the name of the region in the centre of a cyclone where the wind is calm?
questions.solution: The region in the center of a cyclone where the wind is calm is called the eye of the cyclone. This is because the eye is characterized by descending air and low pressure, which results in calm conditions. The other options are not scientifically accurate terms for this specific area.

questions.stem: What happens to the air when it rises and expands in the atmosphere?
questions.solution: When air rises and expands, it loses pressure, which causes it to cool down. This cooling occurs because the air molecules spread out and do not collide as frequently, reducing the temperature. The other options are incorrect because rising air does not become warmer, heavier, or drier as a direct result of expansion.

hi.stem: वायु वातावरण में ऊपर उठती है और फैलती है तो वह क्या हो जाती है?
hi.solution: जब वायु ऊपर उठती है और फैलती है, तो यह दबाव खो देती है, जिसके कारण यह ठंडी हो जाती है। ठंडा होना इसलिए होता है क्योंकि वायु के अणु फैल जाते हैं और आपस में कम टकराते हैं, जिससे तापमान कम हो जाता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि ऊपर उठती वायु फैलने के कारण गर्म, भारी या सूखी नहीं होती।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in a Hindi-medium educational context.

mr.stem: हवा वातावरणात उंचावते आणि विस्तारते तेव्हा काय होते?

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the pressure exerted by a liquid?
choices: It depends on the shape of the container
It depends on the volume of the liquid
It depends on the height of the liquid column
It depends on the surface area of the container
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'It depends on the height of the liquid column.' This is because the pressure exerted by a liquid at a certain depth is directly proportional to the height of the liquid column above that point. The other options are incorrect because pressure does not depend on the shape or surface area of the container, and it is not directly dependent on the volume of the liquid.

questions.stem: A force of 100 N is applied on a cardboard of area 2 m². What is the pressure applied on the cardboard?
questions.solution: The formula for pressure is force divided by area. So, 100 N divided by 2 m² equals 50 N/m². Therefore, the correct answer is 50 N/m². 200 N/m² is the product of force and area, not the pressure. 100 N/m² is the force itself, not the pressure. 25 N/m² is a calculation error.

hi.stem: 100 न्यूटन के बल को 2 वर्ग मीटर के कार्डबोर्ड पर लगाया जाता है। कार्डबोर्ड पर लगा दाब क्या है?
hi.solution: दाब का सूत्र बल को क्षेत्रफल से विभाजित करना है। अतः 100 न्यूटन को 2 वर्ग मीटर से विभाजित करने पर 50 न्यूटन/वर्ग मीटर प्राप्त होता है। अतः सही उत्तर 50 न्यूटन/वर्ग मीटर है। 200 न्यूटन/वर्ग मीटर बल और क्षेत्रफल का गुणनफल है, दाब नहीं। 100 न्यूटन/वर्ग मीटर बल ही है, दाब नहीं। 25 न्यूटन/वर्ग मीटर गणना त्रुटि है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as used in Hindi-medium science textbooks.

mr.stem: 100 न्यूटन बल एका कार्डबोर्डवर 2 चौरस मीटर क्षेत्रफळावर लावला गेला आहे. कार्डबोर्डवर लावलेले दाब किती आहे?
mr.solution: दाबाचा सूत्र बल भागिले क्षेत्रफळ आहे. म्हणून, 100 न्यूटन भागिले 2 मीटर² बरोबर 50 न्यूटन/मीटर² आहे. म्हणून, योग्य उत्तर 50 न्यूटन/मीटर² आहे. 200 न्यूटन/मीटर² हे बल आणि क्षेत्रफळाचे गुणाकार आहे, दाब नाही. 100 न्यूटन/मीटर² हे बल आहे, दाब नाही. 25 न्यूटन/मीटर² हे गणना चूक आहे.

questions.stem: What is the main reason for the formation of a cyclone?
questions.solution: A cyclone forms due to a low pressure system that causes air to rise, creating a continuous cycle of wind and rain. A pupil who thinks high temperature is the main cause might choose 'high temperature'. A pupil who thinks wind is the main cause might choose 'strong wind'. A pupil who thinks rainfall is the main cause might choose 'heavy rainfall'.

questions.stem: If a person is standing on both legs, and the total area of the soles of the feet is 0.2 m², and their weight is 600 N, what is the pressure exerted on the ground?
questions.solution: Pressure is calculated as force divided by area. Here, 600 N divided by 0.2 m² equals 3000 N/m². Therefore, the correct answer is 3000 N/m². 1200 N/m² is the product of force and area, not the pressure. 600 N/m² is the force itself. 300 N/m² is a calculation error.

questions.stem: If two identical balloons are connected by a straw and one is inflated, why do they eventually reach the same size?
choices: Because the pressure inside both balloons becomes the same
Because the temperature inside both balloons becomes the same
Because the amount of air in both balloons becomes the same
Because the material of both balloons becomes the same
questions.solution: The correct answer is because the pressure inside both balloons becomes the same. Air moves from the balloon with higher pressure to the one with lower pressure until the pressures equalize, causing both to expand to the same size. The other options are incorrect because temperature, amount of air, and material do not directly affect the equalization of size in this scenario.
